title: Gacha Economy
description: Economy based around loot gacha bags and hitting the jackpot!
body:
# 🎰 Ultimate Gacha & Jackpot System
**<font color="Gold">Unleash</font>** the thrill of **<font color="Violet">gambling</font>** with our sophisticated **<font color="DeepSkyBlue">Gacha Plugin</font>**! Featuring dynamic animations, a global Jackpot, and a custom economy.

Transform your server into a **high-stakes arena** with **<font color="Violet">15+ unique Gacha Bags</font>**!

---

## 🎯 Core Features

- **🎰 Animated Gacha Opening** - Smooth, immersive GUI ticker animation with high-fidelity sound and particle effects.
- **💰 Global Jackpot System** - 100% of money spent on Gachas accumulates in a server-wide pot. Win it all with a 0.5% chance!
- **🏃 Quick Roll (Skip)** - Too fast for animations? Just press Escape to instantly skip and collect your rewards.
- **🛡️ Item Loss Prevention** - Advanced tracking ensures your items are safe even if you disconnect or close the window.
- **📚 Advanced Enchant Gacha** - Draw real enchanted books (Efficiency V, Sharpness V, etc.) with up-to-date probabilities.
- **💎 Rarity System** - 5 Tiers (Common → Legendary) with distinct visual identities and rarity-scaled rewards.
- **📊 Built-in Economy** - Standard `/money` system included, no external dependencies required.
- **⚡ Performance Optimized** - Written in modern Java 25, designed for stability and zero lag.

---

## 💰 Economy & Earning

Get rich to gamble! Players can earn money through various in-game activities:

- **⛏️ Mining Ores** - High rewards for rare materials.
    - **Ancient Debris**: <font color="Crimson">**$100**</font>
    - **Diamond Ore**: <font color="DeepSkyBlue">**$50**</font>
    - **Emerald Ore**: <font color="LimeGreen">**$40**</font>
    - **Gold/Iron/Lapis**: $8 - $15
- **⚔️ Mob Hunting** - Hunt down enemies for cash.
    - **Bosses (Warden/Wither)**: <font color="Crimson">**$50**</font>
    - **Mid-Tier (Enderman/Blaze)**: <font color="Orange">**$10**</font>
    - **Low-Tier (Zombies/Skeletons)**: <font color="LimeGreen">**$3**</font>
- **🌲 Gathering & Farming** - Stable income from basics.
    - **Logs/Wood**: $1.5
    - **Stone/Earth**: $0.1 - $0.5
    - **Harvesting Crops**: Small rewards for every block broken!

---

## 🎰 The Global Jackpot

Experience the ultimate thrill with our server-wide **Accumulating Jackpot**!

- **💰 How it Grows** - **100%** of every single Gacha purchase (from Food to Rare bags) is added directly to the Jackpot pool.
- **📍 Live Tracking** - See the current pot size in real-time in the Shop GUI or by using the `/jackpot` command.
- **🍀 The Jackpot Gacha** - Purchase a special Jackpot Bag for **$7777** to try your luck!
    - **<font color="Gold">JACKPOT (0.5%)</font>** - Win the **ENTIRE** server pot! (Server-wide broadcast included 📢)
    - **<font color="Gold">$7777 Voucher (2.0%)</font>** - Get your money back!
    - **<font color="Violet">$2222 Voucher (5.5%)</font>** - A small boost to your balance.
    - **<font color="DeepSkyBlue">$500 Voucher (22.0%)</font>** - Better then nothing.
    - **Gold Nugget (70.0%)** - Better luck next time!

---

## 🎮 How to Use

1. **Get the Compass** - Right-click with the Gacha Compass to open the Shop.
2. **Choose Your Bag** - Select from over 15 categories (Ore, Nether, Rare, etc.).
3. **Check the Current Pot** - Use `/jackpot` to see how much money is up for grabs!
4. **Start the Roll** - Buy a bag and watch the animation.
5. **Win Big** - Collect your items or cash vouchers instantly!

---

## 📦 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/gacha`** | Opens the main Shop GUI | *Everyone* |
| **`/jackpot`** | View the current global Jackpot amount | *Everyone* |
| **`/money`** | Check your balance | *Everyone* |
| **`/money pay`** | Pay others | *Everyone* |
| **`/gacha price`** | Set bag prices (Admin Only) | `gacha.admin` |
| **`/gacha give`** | Give specific bags to players | `gacha.admin` |

---

## ✨ Available Gacha Bags (Special Categories)

### **<font color="LimeGreen">Starter Bags</font>**
> **Food Bag**, **Wood Bag**, **Nature Bag**, **Farming Bag**

### **<font color="Orange">Resource Bags</font>**
> **Ore Bag**, **Mob Drop Bag**, **Redstone Bag**, **Ocean Bag**

### **<font color="DeepSkyBlue">Equipment & Magic</font>**
> **Tools Bag**, **Armor Bag**, **Enchant Bag** (Random Level Books!), **Trim Bag**

### **<font color="Violet">Premium & Gambling</font>**
> **Rare Bag** (Elytras, Nether Stars), **Music Bag**, **Gamble Bag** (Go big or go home!), **JACKPOT GACHA**

---

## 🛠️ Requirements & Technicals

| Component | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Minecraft Version** | 1.21.11 (Java Edition) |
| **Server Engine** | Paper or Folia |
| **Java Version** | Java 25 |
| **Persistence** | YAML-based storage for Economy & Jackpot |

---

## 📄 Installation

1. Download the `GachaPlugin.jar`.
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. **Enjoy the Gacha experience!**

---



> **Download Now and hit the Jackpot!** 🚀💰🚀
